01b1.content: Shot 01b1, medium-wide shot in the reception hall (camera position CAM-A, closer than the establishing shot): the elephant stands calmly in the middle of the hall in three-quarter view, filling the center of the frame, breathing, ears relaxed. A medical assistant in light-blue clinic clothes, carrying a stack of patient files, walks past on the left side of the elephant, from right to left, without looking at it, simply stepping around it like around a piece of furniture. Light oak plank floor, the glass front and chairs softly out of focus behind. Large leafy potted plants (a fiddle-leaf fig and a monstera) stand by the glass front. The elephant is physically in the room and lit by the same light: the bright glass front behind it gives a soft bright rim along its back and ears, the side facing the camera is in soft shade, its shadow falls across the floor, dark contact shadows under its feet; matte dusty skin with dried mud on the lower legs. A real photograph taken on location, not a composite, not a 3D rendering. All door signs are blank, no lettering anywhere; posters and screens show only abstract shapes and lines, no text, no numbers, no logos.

02a.content: Shot 02a, very wide 21:9 shot in pure side view (camera position CAM-B): the camera looks straight at the corridor's left wall; in the right third of the frame the light wooden door of the doctor's consulting room is set into this wall. Light grey linoleum floor, white wall with a light oak handrail, a tall green plant in a pot near the door, soft morning light from the windows behind the camera casting soft shadows on the wall. Doctor and elephant both face RIGHT and walk to the right, toward the door, in profile: the doctor walks in front, tablet in hand, calm, slightly nodding as if listening. The elephant walks directly BEHIND him (to the left of him in the frame), following him closely, its head right behind the doctor's back, the trunk curved forward so that the trunk tip is right next to the doctor's ear, as if whispering. The elephant is not in front of him and does not face him. The elephant at natural size just fits under the ceiling. No posters, no monitors in this view. The elephant is lit by the same soft morning light as the doctor; matte dusty skin, dark contact shadows under its feet. A real photograph taken on location, not a composite, not a 3D rendering. All door signs are blank, no lettering anywhere; posters and screens show only abstract shapes and lines, no text, no numbers, no logos.

05a.content: Shot 05a, static wide shot from the waiting area into the corridor (camera position CAM-D), early afternoon. In the left foreground, cut off by the frame edge and slightly soft, the patient sits on her chair, sleeves pulled over her hands, her jacket over the back of the chair next to her and her bag on its seat. In the middle distance the reception counter and the open entrance of the long corridor with grey linoleum. At the far end of the corridor stands the enormous elephant: its body fills the corridor from wall to wall and nearly to the ceiling and completely covers the second door. Three other waiting patients sit on chairs in the hall: an older man with a newspaper, a woman with a child, a young man with headphones. Large leafy potted plants and a floor lamp in the waiting area. Neutral bright daylight from the glass front behind the camera; the elephant in the corridor lit by the corridor windows, matte dusty skin, dark contact shadows. A real photograph taken on location, not a composite, not a 3D rendering. All door signs are blank, no lettering anywhere; posters and screens show only abstract shapes and lines, no text, no numbers, no logos.
